app.header: Hi, I'm Farkhod, an IT teacher at Stanford private school
app.subtext: I teach computer science and digital technologies to students in grades 2-9. Over 4 years, my students and I have completed dozens of learning and creative projects — from first Scratch programs to websites and AI-powered presentations.
app.name: Full name
app.about.desc: Hi! My name is Farkhod. For 4 years I have been teaching computer science and IT subjects at Stanford private school, working with students from grade 2 to grade 9. Together we have built many projects — from first steps in programming and computer literacy to building websites, presentations, and working with artificial intelligence. I enjoy finding simple, clear ways to explain complex technology and watching students build things with their own hands.
